body.name: Pclass
body.construction: \(\mathcal P(d,\kappa,\alpha,\beta,\gamma,L)=\{P:\ P_X=\operatorname{Unif}([0,1]^d),\ e_P=r_{\kappa}g_P/4,\ 1\le g_P\le2,\ g_P\in\mathcal H_d^{\alpha}(L),\ \mu_{0,P}\in\mathcal H_d^{\beta}(L),\ \tau_P\in\mathcal H_d^{\gamma}(L),\ 1/8\le\mu_{0,P},\mu_{1,P}\le7/8,\ Y\mid X=x,A=a\text{ is Bernoulli with mean }\mu_{a,P}(x)\text{ for }P_X\text{-almost every }x,\ Y=Y(A),\ (Y(0),Y(1))\perp A\mid X\}\), where \(\mu_{0,P}\), \(\mu_{1,P}\), \(\nu_{0,P}\), and \(\nu_{1,P}\) denote their unique continuous H\"older versions and \(\tau_P(0)\) is defined only through the continuous extension of \(\mu_{1,P}-\mu_{0,P}\).
